optimizedDescription.value: Hexagonal + DDD: pure domain, port-bound application, edge I/O, shared resolver-backed composition.

optimizedContext.value:
# Architecture

## Rules
- Business-logic packages: `domain` / `application` / `infrastructure`; optional `composition/`; inner layers never import outer
- `domain/`: zero I/O (`fs`/`net`/`child_process`/external HTTP); TypeScript stdlib + domain types only
- Ambient `Logger` MAY be imported from any layer for diagnostics only; composition root wires implementation; not fourth layer
- `application/`: outside world only via ports in `application/ports/`; never imports infrastructure; ambient `Logger` permitted
- Entities own invariants/state transitions; invalid ops throw typed `SpecdError` subclasses; use cases do not duplicate checks
- Value objects expose behaviour via methods/getters; representation private outside class hierarchy
- Ports with invariant ctor args: `abstract class`, invariant fields set in ctor, all operations explicit abstract methods; no property signatures
- Stateless domain services: exported functions in `domain/services/`, not classes
- Manual DI: use-case ctors receive ports; no IoC or module singletons
- `composition/` only layer importing `infrastructure/`; `createKernel(config, options?)` wires grouped use cases; no config mutation; hosts read `kernel.project.getConfig`
- Every Kernel capability available without `createKernel`: `createX(deps)` canonical; `createX(config, options?)` optional convenience through shared normalized config resolver
- `createKernel`/`createKernelBuilder`: convenience over same resolver; no second composition source
- Concrete adapters never public-exported; `@specd/cli`/`@specd/mcp` use `@specd/sdk` when needing core + code-graph
- YAML-reading adapters validate at filesystem boundary; failures `ConfigValidationError`/`SchemaValidationError` extending `SpecdError`; raw YAML never enters domain/application
- Delivery packages (`@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`, `@specd/plugin-*`): no business logic; delivery-to-use-case translation only
- Package deps: `plugin-*` → `skills` → `core`; `cli` → `sdk`; `mcp` → `sdk`; `sdk` → `core`, `code-graph`; `schema-*` no specd deps
- Curated exports: `.` integrator surface/no adapters; `./ports` contracts; `./extensions` registry/factory types; `./internal` dev/advanced; `@specd/sdk` re-exports `./ports` + `./extensions`

## Constraints
- `domain/` must not import `application/`, `infrastructure/`, `composition/`
- `application/` must not import `infrastructure/`, `composition/`; `infrastructure/` must not import `composition/`
- Only `composition/` imports `infrastructure/`; `index.ts` must not export concrete adapters/repository factories
- Delivery uses kernel/factories/config ports, calls returned port methods; no adapter imports/direct use-case construction
- No circular `workspace:*` dependencies
- Public `.` exports kernel-equivalent `createX` + repository factories for every Kernel capability; no adapters/infrastructure
- Ports: `@specd/core/ports`, `@specd/sdk/ports`; extension types: `@specd/core/extensions`, `@specd/sdk/extensions`
- `cli`/`mcp` must not directly depend on core + code-graph when `@specd/sdk` covers needs
